memo.verdict: Bearish; park; conviction medium. ORLEN (PKN-PL) at PLN 144.32 on 2026-10-02 is a cyclical peak dressed as a corporate change: the internal change is real and already in the outputs, the external forces (refining margin normalisation; a windfall tax signed 1-Oct-26; the CPN retail price cap resumed 3-Oct-26) now take the outputs down, and the modal return is -8.8 percent a year to 2028-04-05 and +0.6 percent a year to 2029-10-05 against a 20 percent a year bar. The park rule applies on its own terms: predictability (RA 8, E 2, BB 4) is a D, which parks the case; management B, business quality C and trackability B do not argue against the park. A re-look is earned below about PLN 95, or at any price if the Q4 2026 strategy update cuts the 2035 capex envelope below PLN 300 billion and the FY2027 reported tax rate comes in below 25 percent. The case is a park on the return alone, before any risk is weighed: no evidenced branch, including the bull's at about 9 percent a year, reaches the bar.
case: - The thesis as tested: ORLEN is a cyclical peak dressed as a corporate change. The management installed in April 2024 stopped the capital waste, restored governance and raised the dividend to PLN 8.00; the European refining "Golden Age" lifted earnings to a high the market has paid for at 8.86 times the earnings two years out; from PLN 144.32 the dividend is the only positive leg of the return.

- The internal change is real and in the outputs. Five of twelve internal forces are at B: chief executive change (Fąfara, 10 April 2024, with the Olefins halt, prosecutor reports and a USD 400 million recovery target), other leaders (the finance chief's return; nine Vice Presidents; two new board members), standards (capex PLN 35.3 billion against PLN 38.6 billion guided in 2024 and PLN 32.6 billion against PLN 35.4 billion in 2025; headcount down 1,246; Norges Bank list exit July 2025, a year early; KPMG unmodified opinion), new products (Baltic Power, Grudziądz, HVO, US LNG commissioned, not promised), shareholder returns (PLN 8.00 against PLN 7.20 consensus). The framework's false-positive checks pass except empire-building through state direction (PGZ). Not A because the strategy review is postponed, the PLN 350 to 380 billion envelope stands and the state appoints board members without the company.

- But the change is two and a half years old and propagated. It has travelled all six layers of the 'Six Layer Inputs-outputs' chain: people, choices, actions, operating metrics, financial statements, sell-side estimates (FY2027 consensus EPS +88.9 percent in a year), and the share price (+77.0 percent in twelve months). The contracted catalysts are delivered; the price moved on them; the pattern is price-moved-against-the-park.
counter_case: - At Building Block 1, the prolonged downstream "Golden Age", at full force: European refining closures of 2.5 million barrels a day, the loss of Russian product and crude, Hormuz and Red Sea disruption, OMV and MOL printing USD 20.30 and USD 20.80 per barrel in Q2 2026, Erste's bonanza running into 2027, BOS's USD 27, 21 and 16 per barrel path for 2026 to 2028, and ORLEN hedging only 20 percent of its cracks so the upside stays open. The state has shown restraint: it let the PLN 8.00 dividend through, Moody's affirmed A3 saying resources cover peak investment and payouts, the windfall tax is a PLN 4 billion sector figure and Erste's reading is PLN 4.1 billion cumulative over three years, so the extraction is bounded; the chief executive publicly rejected pressure on prices. Baltic Power and the CCGTs add contracted EBITDA from 2027. On that path EPS holds near PLN 20 through FY2028, the multiple holds at 8.7x, and a national champion the state cannot let fail at 8.9x with a 5.5 percent yield is cheap. Five of nine brokers say Buy, with targets to PLN 185.

- The record's concessions: the margin may stay above mid-cycle through 2027 (possible, about one in three); the tax may prove nearer PLN 1.5 billion a year than PLN 6 billion; the management is good; the dividend is safe for two years on the balance sheet alone; the transition assets are arriving on time.
triggers: - Re-look: a price below about PLN 95; or at any price if the Q4 2026 strategy update cuts the 2035 capex envelope below PLN 300 billion and the FY2027 reported tax rate comes in below 25 percent. The modal path clears the bar at about PLN 85 (the three-year test binds); fair value today about PLN 113.

- The refining margin (Key Driver): our modal USD 8 to 9 per barrel by 2027; Alarm a sustained model margin above USD 14 per barrel through Q1 2027 (with the differential back above USD 8); Invalidate a model margin above USD 16 per barrel for four consecutive quarters.

- State extraction (Key Risk): our modal PLN 3 billion in 2027, PLN 2 billion in 2028, PLN 1.5 billion in 2029; Alarm a repeal or sunset clause; Invalidate a reported tax rate below 25 percent for FY2027. The tax line (Key Risk): our modal about 35 percent all-in for FY2027; Alarm a rate below 25 percent.

- Capex and free cash flow (Key Risk): our modal capex PLN 34 billion in 2027 and net debt about PLN 35 billion by end-2028; Alarm the strategy update cutting the 2035 envelope below PLN 300 billion; Invalidate positive free cash flow after dividends in FY2027.
- The multiple (Key Risk): our modal 7.5x; Alarm a move above 10.0x; no Invalidate level (a price, not a fundamental).

- Consensus FY2027 EPS (Risk): our modal PLN 17.0 against the PLN 19.36 median; Alarm a rise above PLN 21; Invalidate consensus above PLN 23 with the windfall tax in the numbers. Consensus FY2028 EPS above PLN 20 with the windfall tax in the numbers would change the view that the transition assets hold EPS at PLN 15 to 17.
